text: For the one directing. According to “The Lilies.” Of David. 1 Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to the soul.
I sink in the mire of the deep, and there is no place to stand; I have come into the depths of the waters, and a flood washes over me.
I have grown weary with my calling out; my throat is dry; my eyes fail, waiting for my God.
Those hating me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those seeking my destruction, my enemies [with] deception! That which I did not steal, I must then return.
O God, You know of my foolishness, and my guilt [is] not hidden from You.
Do not let those waiting on You come to shame because of me, O Lord YHWH of hosts; do not let those seeking You be disgraced because of me, O God of Israel!
[It is] for Your sake that I have carried scorn, [and] shame has covered my face.
I have become a stranger to my brothers, and a foreigner to the sons of my mother.
For zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those insulting You have fallen on me.
I even wept in the fasting of my soul, and it was for a reproach to me.
I made my clothing sackcloth, and I became to them as a byword.
Those sitting [at] the gate meditate against me, and I am the song of those drinking wine.
And I—my prayer [is] to You, O YHWH; [in] the time of favor, O God, in the abundance of Your loving devotion, may You answer me in the truth of Your salvation!
Deliver me from the mire, that I should not sink! May I be delivered from those hating me, and out of the depths of the waters.
Do not let the flood of waters engulf me, and do not let the deep swallow me up, and do not let the pit shut its mouth over me!
Answer me, O YHWH, for good [is] Your loving devotion; according to the abundance of Your tender mercies, turn to me.
And do not hide Your face from Your servant, for distress [is] unto me; hurry to answer me!
Draw near to my soul [and] redeem it; on account of my enemies, may You ransom me.
You know my scorn, and my shame, and my disgrace; all my adversaries [are] before You.
Reproach has broken my heart, and I am sick. And I looked for a bemoaner, and there was none, and for comforters, and I found none.
And they gave gall for my food, and for my thirst they made me drink vinegar.
May their table before them become a snare, and for a recompense—for a trap!
May their eyes grow dark from seeing, and their backs be bent forever!
Pour out upon them Your indignation, and may the burning of Your anger overtake them!
May their encampment become desolate; may there be no one dwelling in their tents.
For You—the one whom You struck—they pursue, and the pain of those You pierced they recount.
May You add iniquity to their iniquity, and do not let them come into Your righteousness!
May they be blotted out from the book of the living, and do not let them be written with the righteous!
And I [am] afflicted and pained; may Your salvation, O God, set me on high.
I will praise the name of God with a song, and will I magnify Him with thanksgiving.
And it is better to YHWH than an ox, a bull horned [and] hoofed.
The humble have seen—they rejoice—you seeking God, your⁺ heart shall live!
For YHWH listens to the needy, and he has not despised His captives.
Let the heavens and earth shout praise to Him, the seas, and every moving thing in them.
For God will save Zion, and He will rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.
And the seed of His servants will inherit it, and those loving His name will settle in it.
